articles.title: Workday opens live enterprise data to AI agents
articles.summary: Workday Data Cloud gives agents access to live business data, existing permissions, and business logic without requiring duplicate datasets or rebuilt security controls. Agent Lake and Live Data Query are generally available, while semantic models and tools for governed agent actions remain in early access.

articles.title: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to public benefit fund
articles.summary: Anthropic is allocating 5% of its shares to a new fund that could support nonprofits and direct distributions to populations affected by AI. Together with founder and employee pledges, the company says roughly 20% of its equity is now dedicated to public benefit.

articles.title: Microsoft plans to pay Anthropic over $2B a year to keep Copilot competitive
articles.summary: Microsoft reportedly plans to pay Anthropic over $2 billion annually to use Claude AI models within its Copilot assistant. The integration responds to client performance pressures and aims to improve output on tasks like financial automation and presentations. To manage costs, Microsoft employs an internal model router that directs some workloads to OpenAI models.

articles.title: If you can't automate your workflow, neither can your users' agents
articles.summary: When developers struggle to automate their own workflows, AI coding agents will encounter the exact same friction, making workflow obstacles a critical product problem. Workflows designed around human navigation, portals, and undocumented knowledge cause high failure rates and excessive token costs for agents. Developers should evaluate their products by testing them with goal-oriented agent prompts rather than relying solely on usage telemetry or manual workarounds.

articles.title: What happens when AI agents work more hours than employees?
articles.summary: Anthropic's internal research found that interactive agent hours outnumbered employee hours six to one by August, while output increased and junior technical roles represented a smaller share of hiring. Human attention is becoming a bottleneck, pushing employees toward monitoring agent pipelines and hiring managers toward prioritizing judgment and autonomy.

articles.title: ServiceNow AI Control Tower: Selling a penthouse while building the frame
articles.summary: ServiceNow's AI Control Tower provides a strong governance workflow and system of action for enterprise AI. However, customer interviews reveal that claims of end-to-end technical governance and a universal runtime kill switch are overstated, with runtime enforcement typically handled by external or custom tools. Additionally, customers face meaningful friction regarding configuration costs, CMDB hygiene, and pricing tier uplifts.

articles.title: ServiceNow Plans AI Passport for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: ServiceNow's AI Passport is a governance tool designed to control and verify the permissions of artificial-intelligence agents during execution. Nvidia is a design and launch partner for the tool, which is expected to become available in the fourth quarter of 2026 alongside other enterprise products.

articles.title: Honeywell launches AI agents to manage building alarms, maintenance and energy
articles.summary: Honeywell Technologies has introduced Forge Cognition, a platform combining AI agents with live facility simulations to help operators manage building alarms, maintenance, and energy use. Developed using technology from NVIDIA and Dell Technologies, the platform offers adjustable automation ranging from manual to autonomous oversight. Early pilot testing at NVIDIA's Voyager campus and other sites demonstrated significant reductions in unnecessary alerts and potential energy savings.

articles.title: AI pricing tools face a consumer trust problem
articles.summary: Retailers are adopting AI-assisted pricing and digital shelf labels, but consumers remain confused about how personal data influences prices. The reporting separates actual practices from misconceptions and highlights how limited transparency can undermine trust in otherwise routine technology upgrades.

articles.title: Firefox Enterprise 158 puts browser policy, data controls and AI governance on customer-run infrastructure
articles.summary: Mozilla announced the early access of Firefox Enterprise 158, featuring a self-hosted admin console, domain-scoped data-loss prevention, and governance controls for AI tools. Aimed at organizations in France, Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, the management plane runs on customer infrastructure rather than relying solely on cloud-hosted alternatives or standard MDM policies.

articles.title: AI and SaaS workloads drive Akamai cloud adoption
articles.summary: Akamai reports new cloud deployments spanning GPU workloads, disaster recovery, and a developer platform migrating nearly 1,500 microservices from a major hyperscaler to reduce costs.

articles.title: The AI NOC Engineer: Building an Autonomous DevOps Agent with Amazon Q and CloudWatch
articles.summary: The architecture uses Amazon SQS, AWS Fargate, and LangGraph for cyclical agentic reasoning, Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Q for root cause analysis, and AWS Step Functions to implement a Human-in-the-Loop Slack approval gate before executing automated remediation.
